title: [Dev] When Superbolus is used, it is not possible to return to Closed loop
body: Build: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/f498b3265f41a61862bd3e522e53077cf2131669 To reproduce: 1. Enable Superbolus and use bolus wizard and tick for superbolus. Actual result: Running mode is set to Superbolus - but it is not possible to return to closed loop manually.

comments.body: that's by design. superbolus stops loop
